resources.string: Takes effect on this screen straight away. The CarPlay picture itself picks it up on the next connection.
Automatic mode uses the threshold and delay below; without a light sensor, it follows Android.
CarPlay Automatic also uses iPhone time: at night, Always day may still appear dark.
DiPlay cannot see an ambient light sensor or a day/night flag from this head unit, so the two automatic modes may stay in daylight. Use 固定日间 or 固定夜间.
